name: Heavy-duty DOT 4 Brake Fluid

features.text: Contains special additives and esters for excellent high-temperature protection and moisture resistance.
Extremely high-boiling point formula Dry ERBP: > 260°C (> 500°F), Wet ERBP: >175°C (>346°F)
Exceeds DOT specifications for DOT 4 brake fluid (DOT minimum is 446°F).
Two convenient sizes for use with fluid exchange equipment.
Product is compatible and may be used in place of DOT 3.

description: A high quality product which meets and exceeds the DOT specifications for DOT 4 brake fluid.
application: This product is to be used with a #98000 MOC® Pure Brake™ Brake-Fluid Exchanger. Follow directions in the machine’s instruction manual for use of this product.
review: Bottle photo is only 369 px tall
Spelling corrected from the old sheet: ERPB -> ERBP; ◦ -> °

ad.headline: High Performance
ad.description: A premium, high boiling point brake fluid designed for vehicles with disc or drum brakes and wherever a DOT 4 fluid is recommended in both domestic and foreign vehicles. Meets or exceeds DOT Vehicle Safety Standard.
benefits: Extremely high-boiling point formula Dry ERBP: > 262°C (> 503°F), Wet ERBP: >175°C (>346°F)
Exceeds DOT specifications for DOT 4 brake fluid, (DOT minimum is 446°F).
Excellent high-temperature protection and moisture resistance.
Product can be mixed with other DOT 3 or DOT 4 products.
